correctness.rationale: Orbit classification uses one A_n-orbit in word lengths k≤n−2 and two parity orbits for k=n−1,n. Deleted-letter positional boundaries alternate zero/one in one-cell range; top matrices have Smith diag(1,n) for odd n and rank-one invariant n/2 for even n. Independent orbit-word incidence and Smith computations n=3..7 match including boundary compositions and exact torsion. For n≥5 odd and n≥4 even, lower-skeleton degree-one cancellations and wedge attaching-cell changes realize Moore spaces; the n=3 presentation reduces to <a|a^3>. Finite checks corroborate all-n parity argument.
